title: Operate
description: Operators plus motions: d, c, y, the dot command, and text objects.

levels.title: Kill the typo
levels.description: Remove the stray word 'fxo' so the sentence reads correctly.
start_text: The quick brown fxo jumps over the lazy dog

value: The quick brown jumps over the lazy dog

levels.hint: Jump to the typo with f, then delete the word with dw.

levels.title: Security through deletion
levels.description: Someone committed a password. Delete that whole line before the auditors arrive.

levels.title: Change of heart
levels.description: Be honest about your preferences: turn 'meetings' into 'naps'.
levels.hint: Get to the word, then cw deletes to the end of it and drops you into Insert mode. <Esc> when done.

levels.title: Inside job
levels.description: Empty the string, but keep the quotes. The world has heard enough.
levels.hint: di" deletes inside the quotes, and finds the next quoted string if you are not in one yet.

levels.title: Rename
levels.description: Nobody knows what a thingamajig is. Rename it to 'answer' without leaving the word.
levels.hint: ciw changes the whole word under the cursor, wherever the cursor is inside it.

levels.title: Dot dot dot
levels.description: Declare victory: remove 'TODO ' from every line. Do it once, then let . do the rest.
levels.hint: . repeats the last change. Try dw, then j and . for each line.

levels.title: Plausible deniability
levels.description: On second thought, nobody needs to know. Delete the middle paragraph and the blank line after it.
levels.hint: dap deletes a paragraph, including the blank line that follows it.

levels.title: Ship it
levels.description: One 'Ship it!' is not enough. Make it three lines of pure confidence.
levels.hint: yy yanks the line, p puts it below. p takes a count too.
